source.inventory: Every concrete Record class published by androidx.health.connect:connect-client, excluding the abstract supertypes Record, InstantaneousRecord, IntervalRecord, and SeriesRecord.

sourceTypeExtension.rule: Every admitted output preserves the exact AndroidX Health Connect 1.1 Record class token; the token is lineage and does not replace Observation.code.

dataOriginApplication.rule: Carry one complete absolute-system Identifier on the typed logical Device Reference. The package name identifies an application product, not an installation, host, account, person, or physical recording device.

statusVocabulary.supported: The current adapter defines and validates emitted FHIR output.
statusVocabulary.mapped-standard: The source maps directly to an established external FHIR profile without a Grove semantic profile.
statusVocabulary.platform-exclusive: The current adapter defines output through a platform-exclusive Health Connect profile whose meaning remains source-specific.
statusVocabulary.unmodeled: The source type is inventoried, but no shared or Health Connect-scoped profile models it and no output is admitted.
statusVocabulary.deferred: No FHIR output for this source type is admitted by the current adapter.
statusVocabulary.intentionally-unsupported: The Grove FHIR contracts explicitly reject this source meaning rather than approximating it.

observationIssued.rule: Map the exact Health Connect Metadata.lastModifiedTime to Observation.issued as the source store's availability time for this current Record version. Never substitute conversion, fetch, assembly, or upload time.

outputCountRules.exactly-one: Emit exactly one output for the source record.
outputCountRules.zero-or-one: Emit no more than one output, under the named source-presence condition.
outputCountRules.one-per-sample: Emit exactly one output for every source sample and no others.
outputCountRules.one-per-stage: Emit exactly one output for every source sleep stage and no others.
outputCountRules.one-per-present-field: Emit exactly one output for every present named source field and none for absent fields.
outputCountRules.graph-specific: Apply the closed graphRule named on the output; no free-text counting interpretation is permitted.

exactly-one-admitted-specimen-output.cardinality: For exactly one admitted BloodGlucoseRecord specimen source, emit exactly one matching glucose Observation and exactly one synthesized Specimen; emit no other output for that source record.
exactly-one-admitted-specimen-output.projectionRule: The Observation references the Specimen, both carry the same source-record identifier, each has a distinct source-output identifier, and the one conversion Provenance targets both resources.

outputs.discriminator: the exact selected adapter measurement id
the exact admitted source specimen token

one-per-source-segment-or-lap.cardinality: Emit exactly one workout-segment Observation for every ExerciseSegment and every ExerciseLap in their preserved source-list order; emit no other workout child.
one-per-source-segment-or-lap.projectionRule: Every interval is within the parent session. ExerciseLap uses the exact synthetic source token EXERCISE_LAP; ExerciseSegment uses its exact AndroidX token.

outputs.discriminator: <canonical UTC start with nine fractional digits>|<canonical UTC end with nine fractional digits>|<exact source segment token or EXERCISE_LAP>|<canonical zero-based occurrence among identical coordinates in preserved source-list order>

one-per-source-delta.cardinality: Emit exactly one skin-temperature Observation for every source delta and no others; reject a record containing deltas when its baseline is absent.
one-per-source-delta.projectionRule: The value is the exact baseline plus delta in degrees Celsius; identity never includes that measured value.

outputs.discriminator: <canonical UTC delta instant with nine fractional digits>|<canonical zero-based occurrence among identical instants in preserved source-list order>

recordTypes.title: Planned Exercise Session
recordTypes.reason: A planned exercise session states future intent rather than an observed measurement, so it has no place in a measurement contract. R4 CarePlan would carry it if a deployment ever needs the plan itself.

bloodGlucoseMealContext.unknownPolicy: omit the unknown subextension; omit the complex extension when both fields are unknown

menstruationFlow.r4Element: Observation.valueCodeableConcept.coding (additional exact-source coding after the shared Grove flow coding)
menstruationFlow.unknownPolicy: preserve FLOW_UNKNOWN; reject integers outside the closed AndroidX 1.1 domain

ovulationTestResult.r4Element: Observation.valueCodeableConcept.coding (additional exact-source coding after the shared Grove result coding)
ovulationTestResult.unknownPolicy: reject integers outside the closed AndroidX 1.1 domain

sexualActivityProtection.r4Element: Observation.valueCodeableConcept.coding (additional exact-source coding after the shared Grove protection coding)
sexualActivityProtection.unknownPolicy: preserve PROTECTION_USED_UNKNOWN; reject integers outside the closed AndroidX 1.1 domain

cervicalMucusAppearance.r4Element: Observation.valueCodeableConcept.coding (additional exact-source coding after the shared Grove appearance coding)
cervicalMucusAppearance.unknownPolicy: preserve APPEARANCE_UNKNOWN; reject integers outside the closed AndroidX 1.1 domain

cervicalMucusSensation.r4Element: Observation.component[cervical-mucus-sensation].valueCodeableConcept.coding (additional exact-source coding after the shared Grove sensation coding)
cervicalMucusSensation.unknownPolicy: omit SENSATION_UNKNOWN; reject integers outside the closed AndroidX 1.1 domain

exerciseType.r4Element: workout summary Observation.valueCodeableConcept.coding (additional exact-source coding after the shared Grove activity coding)
exerciseType.unknownPolicy: reject integers outside the closed AndroidX 1.1 domain

exerciseSegmentType.r4Element: workout-segment Observation.valueCodeableConcept.coding (additional exact-source coding after the shared Grove segment coding)
exerciseSegmentType.unknownPolicy: preserve EXERCISE_SEGMENT_TYPE_UNKNOWN; use EXERCISE_LAP for structural laps; reject every other out-of-domain integer or token

sessionTitle.appliesTo: the primary workout, sleep-duration, or mindfulness-session summary Observation only
sessionTitle.retentionPolicy: RETAIN preserves the non-blank source field; OMIT deliberately omits it; the producer must explicitly select one

exerciseNotes.authorAndTime: omit because Health Connect supplies neither
exerciseNotes.retentionPolicy: RETAIN preserves the non-blank source field; OMIT deliberately omits it; the producer must explicitly select one

sleepStage.r4Element: Observation.valueCodeableConcept.coding (additional coding after the shared Grove stage coding)

sleepNotes.authorAndTime: omit because Health Connect supplies neither
sleepNotes.retentionPolicy: RETAIN preserves the non-blank source field; OMIT deliberately omits it; the producer must explicitly select one

mindfulnessSessionType.unknownPolicy: preserve the AndroidX UNKNOWN token; reject integers outside the closed AndroidX 1.1 domain

mindfulnessNotes.authorAndTime: omit because Health Connect supplies neither
mindfulnessNotes.retentionPolicy: RETAIN preserves the non-blank source field; OMIT deliberately omits it; the producer must explicitly select one

vo2MaxMeasurementMethod.unknownPolicy: reject integers outside the closed AndroidX 1.1 domain

recordingDeviceIdentity.stableUnitToken: Health Connect 1.1 exposes no per-unit device identifier. A producer may emit Observation.device only when its caller supplies a separately governed stable per-unit token.
recordingDeviceIdentity.fallback: Omit Observation.device when that token is absent. Manufacturer, model, device type, repository scope, and their digest do not establish a physical instance.
recordingDeviceIdentity.snapshot: When emitted, the Device carries both recording-device and event-scoped device-snapshot v0 identifiers.

bindings.repository-scope-system: deployment-owned URI naming the Health Connect repository scope
bindings.repository-scope-value: stable pseudonymous value for one on-device Health Connect repository
bindings.native-record-id: Metadata.id exactly as returned by Health Connect

sourceOutput.outputRoleRule: Use exactly one role from outputRoles. A non-graph count rule selects its named role; a graph-specific rule declares the role for every graph output.

outputDiscriminatorRules.exactly-one: output-role single; discriminator is the exact measurement id
outputDiscriminatorRules.one-per-sample: output-role sample; discriminator is <canonical UTC instant with nine fractional digits>|<canonical zero-based occurrence>
outputDiscriminatorRules.one-per-stage: output-role sleep-stage; discriminator is <canonical UTC start with nine fractional digits>|<canonical UTC end with nine fractional digits>|<exact source stage token>|<canonical zero-based occurrence>
outputDiscriminatorRules.one-per-present-field: output-role present-field; discriminator is the exact measurement id
outputDiscriminatorRules.specimen: output-role specimen; discriminator is the exact admitted source specimen token
outputDiscriminatorRules.graph-specific: the named graph rule must declare an exact output role and delimiter-safe canonical discriminator

sourceOutput.canonicalOccurrence: 0 or a non-zero ASCII digit followed by zero or more ASCII digits; no sign or leading zero.
sourceOutput.ordering: For an ordered Health Connect sample or stage list, preserve the exact platform list order and assign the zero-based occurrence among entries with identical canonical non-value coordinates in that order. Never sort by a measured value and never use unordered map, set, or runtime iteration. If the source list order was not retained, reject duplicate coordinates rather than mint unstable identities.

bindings.writer-application-system: deployment-owned URI naming Android application package identifiers

writerRecord.version: When Metadata.clientRecordId is present, carry Metadata.clientRecordVersion exactly, including the AndroidX default 0; never infer presence or synthesize a value from export order.

revision.identifierRule: A present clientRecordId must be non-blank and is used exactly as the writer-record-id component; an absent id omits both writer identity and version.
revision.versionRule: The AndroidX Long is always available and defaults to 0; with a present clientRecordId emit its canonical unsigned decimal text, including 0.

identity.resourceIdPolicy: Resource.id is optional and repository-assigned. Platform, output, writer, specimen, and event business identifiers are never copied into Resource.id.
